name: scrapecreators
description: Connect Scrape Creators to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Scrape Creators MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Scrape Creators to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with public social media data using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Scrape Creators workspace.
Find anything in Scrape Creators that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review public social media data in Scrape Creators.
